tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Mammoth Analytics docs and return the best-matching pages.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch one documentation page's full markdown content. `path` may be a doc path ("learn/x.md"), a site route ("/docs/learn/x/"), or a full docs URL (including a ".md"-suffixed one).

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List documentation pages, optionally only one top-level section (learn, build, agents, guides).
